# Pinned ContractionPPO reference

Repository: https://github.com/contractionppo/ContractionPPO

Commit: `e63ed83516e46a2630ad203115d069d83de98f4b`

These files are verbatim reference snapshots for numerical parity tests and implementation review. They are not imported as executable training packages.

- `upstream_algorithm.py`: `source/ContractionPPO/ContractionPPO/contraction_ppo/algorithms/contraction_ppo.py`
- `upstream_metric.py`: `source/ContractionPPO/ContractionPPO/contraction_ppo/modules/contraction_metric.py`
- `upstream_handstand_cfg.py`: `source/ContractionPPO/ContractionPPO/tasks/manager_based/handstand/agents/rsl_rl_ppo_cfg.py`

`provenance.json` records URLs, the commit and SHA-256 hashes. Original copyright and SPDX notices are retained. The algorithm file identifies BSD-3-Clause licensing and ETH Zurich/NVIDIA copyright; the configuration identifies BSD-3-Clause licensing and Isaac Lab copyright. Upstream `setup.py` additionally declares the project package license as MIT. The local adapted implementation records its provenance in `docs/contractionppo.md`.
